title: Greensleeves on Every Street
subject: An ice-cream van driver whose chime box is jammed on four bars of one tune sells out on every estate because children chase it, and decides to build his whole route around it.
caption: Colombian cumbia-pop in a bouncing dance-band style. Bright accordion carrying the melody, guacharaca scraper on the offbeats, tumbadora and alegre drums in the cumbia pattern, bouncing electric bass on the one-and-three, tambora, short bright brass stabs. Live Latin dance-band mix, bright accordion, warm percussion, polished. Male tenor lead with party shouts from a small group, cheerful and energetic. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 96 BPM, C major. Upbeat, funny, danceable. No rap, no autotune, no EDM drops, no trap hi-hats, no distorted guitars, no synth leads.
lyrics:
[Intro - guacharaca, drums, accordion hook]

[Verse 1]
My chime box broke back in June
It plays four bars and will not stop
Same four bars, up and down the street
The children hear it, and out they come

[Pre-Chorus]
Eighty-nine kids on Maple Road
All of them running after me

[Chorus]
Ding-ding-ding-dong, ding-ding-ding-dong
Greensleeves on every street
Ding-ding-ding-dong, ding-ding-ding-dong
Everybody dance to the van

[Verse 2]
A dog on Elm sings along with me
The old man on Pine taps on his cane
Mrs Okoro waves her tea towel
Strawberry cone for a pound ten

[Pre-Chorus]
The garage said they could fix it
I said no, leave it be

[Chorus]
Ding-ding-ding-dong, ding-ding-ding-dong
Greensleeves on every street
Ding-ding-ding-dong, ding-ding-ding-dong
Everybody dance to the van

[Bridge - accordion and percussion only]
Stop the van, line up, line up

[Chorus]
Ding-ding-ding-dong, ding-ding-ding-dong
Sold out by half past four
Ding-ding-ding-dong, ding-ding-ding-dong
Everybody dance to the van

[Outro - accordion, drums, brass stab ending]
Ding-ding-ding-dong
